paste:
SIKA® FOAM BACKER ROD CLOSED CELL: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell, July 2025, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sika_foam_backerrodclosedcell.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2025, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell is manufactured from closed cell, low density, polyethylene foam. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell has excellent compression and recovery properties, is available in various sizes and lengths. The round profile assists in providing the correct joint sealant profile allowing optimum movement capability.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell is used as a backing rod for horiontal and vertical expansion joints placed prior to the application of sealants. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell provides bond breaking, assists in the control of joint depths for correct joint design, allows for proper sealant tooling, improves contact with joint flanks and reducing sealant consumption.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: CLOSED CELL BACKING ROD
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2025, Version 01.03) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Quick and easy installation
    - Closed cell
    - Assists with joint design
    - Assists with sealant profile
    - Provides a bond breaker, avoids three sided adhesion
    - Compatible with cold applied sealants (polyurethane, silicone)
    - Highly flexible and compressible
    - Good water and temperature resistance
    - Reduces sealant consumption
    - Excellent compression recovery
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Low density polyethylene closed cell foam
    - Density: 40-50kg/m³ nominal
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: 60 months from the date of production
    - Storage conditions: Dry, warm conditions preferred.
2.6 Packaging.
    | Diameter | Length |
    | 6mm | 250m |
    | 10mm | 250m |
    | 20mm | 60m |
    | 30mm | 50m |

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2025, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 Application. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2025, Version 01.03) states no application requirements.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2025, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Foam Backer Rod Closed Cell, July 2025, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/sika_foam_backerrodclosedcell.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
